what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Nigeria in Ireland: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7113 Nigerian asylum seekers in Ireland, 12.7% of all asylum seekers from Nigeria.
Refugees from Nigeria, a separate group, live mostly in Niger, Cameroon, Chad and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Nigeria with JAS in 2009 and from 2011 to 2025, and with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over Biafra territory with IPOB from 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2003 at 2592 asylum seekers, and UNHCR reports no figure above zero for 2005.
The figure then rose and is at its highest at the end of 2025; the main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Ireland.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Ireland only.
